title: Chicken Mediterranean Flatbread
description: A flavorful and crunchy Italian-inspired flatbread topped with juicy chicken and Mediterranean spices.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt, pepper, and 1 teaspoon of mediterranean seasoning.
Bake the chicken in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, brush the flatbread with warm olive oil and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of mediterranean seasoning.
Bake the flatbread in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Slice the cooked chicken into thin strips.
Assemble the flatbread by topping it with the chicken, crunchy feta cheese, and fresh parsley.
Drizzle with additional warm olive oil, if desired.
